jobs.title: Editorial Content Strategist, Digital & Insights
jobs.description:
Who We Are

FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.

At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.

Are you ready to make your impact?

Our Corporate Positioning and Insights (CPI&I) practice seeks a talented, versatile Editorial Content Strategist
with 6+ years of experience to join the team in our New York, Chicago or Washington, D.C. office. We’re looking for a multidisciplinary content strategist who will sit at the intersection of earned media, digital strategy, and creative production. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, has strong instincts for what makes a story land, and can move seamlessly from strategy to execution. You'll work in close partnership with our media relations team, serving as the content engine that creates powerful stories to amplify across channels.

What You'll Do

Lead rapid response content development across earned, owned, and paid channels for large scale campaign — from breaking news moments to proactive campaign beats
Serve as the editorial and strategic lead on content that reaches a variety of audiences, including but not limited to media, policymakers and regulators
Monitor news cycles, track emerging trends, and identify opportunities to insert clients into relevant conversations
Draft and edit a range of content quickly and with precision, including press materials, digital copy, paid media scripts, executive messaging, and more
Develop content strategies for long-term reputation building projects, ensuring consistent narrative continuity across campaigns, channels, and client touchpoints
Partner closely with the media relations team to ensure content is strategically aligned, on message, and ready to move at the pace of the news cycle
Collaborate with digital, creative, and design teams to concept and produce campaign assets aligned to strategic objectives
Partner across practice areas to ensure content is integrated, consistent, and ladders up to broader campaign goals
Bring a journalist's instincts and a strategist's discipline to everything you write and produce
Collaborate with SEO, AEO, and analytics experts to optimize content performance and discoverability.
Stay current on emerging content trends, AI tools, audience behaviors, and platform best practices.

How You’ll Grow

We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You’ll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.

As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.

Basic Qualifications

What You Will Need to Succeed

6+ years of experience in communications, PR, content strategy, or a related field
Deep understanding of the media landscape and what makes content newsworthy — without necessarily owning media relationships directly
Strong writing across formats — long-form, short-form, organic social, paid media, executive voice
Experience translating data and insights into multichannel content
Experience working in or alongside digital and creative teams on integrated campaigns
Comfort with the creative concepting process and ability to brief and collaborate with designers and producers
Ability to manage multiple workstreams under deadline pressure
Strong project management capabilities, including oversight of multichannel, integrated campaigns, with a proven ability to manage senior and junior team members

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in public affairs, policy, or regulated industries is a plus
Experience working with optimization for SEO and LLMs

jobs.description:
About the Company

Since 2008, EnVogue International has been a leader in trend-driven home décor, partnering with major retailers across North America to bring innovative products from concept to shelf. Through a collaborative design process and an established global manufacturing network, we develop high-quality products across a diverse portfolio that includes bedding, decorative pillows, kitchen linen, rugs, bath accessories, home fragrance, stationery, furniture, tabletop, and more.

About the Role

As the Design Director for Decorative Pillows
, you will lead the creative direction, design, and merchandising of EnVogue’s decorative pillow collections. This role combines strong design expertise, trend forecasting, merchandising, and team leadership to develop innovative, commercially successful assortments for major retailers.

You will lead and mentor the design team while partnering closely with Sales, Product Development, Sourcing, and Production to bring seasonal collections from concept through production.

Responsibilities

Lead the creative vision and design direction for seasonal decorative pillow collections.
Research and forecast trends across color, print, pattern, materials, texture, and home décor.
Translate trends and customer insights into compelling, commercially relevant product assortments.
Oversee line building and merchandising, including product mix, color stories, price points, and retailer-specific assortments.
Direct the development of prints, patterns, embroideries, textures, fabrications, and decorative techniques.
Lead, mentor, and manage the design team, providing creative direction and overseeing priorities and timelines.
Review artwork, tech packs, samples, and specifications to ensure design intent and quality are maintained through production.
Partner with Sales on customer needs, showroom presentations, buyer meetings, and product development opportunities.
Collaborate with Sourcing and Production to meet design, quality, margin, and target pricing requirements.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Textile Design, Fashion Design, Surface Design, Fine Arts, or related field.
8+ years of design experience within decorative pillows, home textiles, soft home, home décor, or related categories.
Proven experience leading and managing design teams.
Strong background in hands-on design, merchandising, line building, and trend forecasting.
Strong knowledge of color, print and pattern, textiles, fabrications, and product construction.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.
Strong understanding of retail product development and overseas manufacturing.
Portfolio demonstrating relevant design experience and creative leadership required.

Why Join EnVogue International?

Global Impact
- Work directly with international manufacturing partners and help bring products to market on a global scale.
Drive Operational Excellence
- Play a critical role in ensuring product quality, profitability, and on-time delivery.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with Design, Product Development, Sourcing, Sales, and Logistics teams to drive business success.
Growth Opportunity
- Join a growing organization where your expertise directly influences product execution, operational performance, and company growth.

jobs.title: Senior Investments Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Citi Wealth is seeking an exceptional Senior Investments Content Strategist to join the Content & Client Engagement team — a senior, strategic role at the intersection of investment expertise, multi-format content production, and client communication.

This is not a support role. You are a recognised authority in investments content strategy — someone who brings deep knowledge of the wealth management investment landscape, a sophisticated understanding of how complex financial strategies are positioned and communicated across formats, and the credibility to operate at the most senior levels of a large, global organisation. You follow the latest developments in your field closely and adapt them with speed and intelligence to the demands of the business.

Your remit spans the full breadth of Citi Wealth's investment product portfolio — from equities and fixed income to multi-asset strategies and alternative investments. You are not a specialist in one asset class or one content format. You are the person who understands how a sophisticated investment idea needs to be expressed differently depending on whether it is a whitepaper for an institutional advisor, a short-form video for a digital channel, a panel discussion at a marquee client conference, or a monthly fact sheet for a relationship manager's client meeting. You move between those formats with fluency and with consistently high standards.

You will partner with senior members of Citi Wealth's global and regional marketing and investment leadership to develop integrated content strategies that bring the firm's investment capabilities to life — across written, video, audio, event, and digital formats. You will be the connective tissue between investment teams, product, legal, compliance, and the broader content function — ensuring that Citi Wealth's investment value proposition is communicated with clarity, precision, and genuine differentiation.

You operate with the same dual metabolism that defines the best investment content professionals: responsive and fast when markets move and opportunities arise; meticulous and considered when developing the flagship collateral, capability narratives, and quarterly programs that form the backbone of Citi Wealth's client communications calendar. You understand that in a regulated financial environment, every word — and every frame — carries weight.

Responsibilities:

Content Strategy & Integrated Campaign Development

Partner with senior members of Citi Wealth's global marketing and regional marketing leads to seek out and develop integrated content strategies and campaigns in alignment with agreed business and marketing plans — across the full spectrum of Citi Wealth's investment product portfolio.
Bring a strategic, audience-first perspective to every brief — ensuring that investment content is grounded in a clear understanding of client needs, competitive positioning, and the prevailing investment landscape.
Stay closely attuned to the latest trends in investment content strategy, wealth management communication, and financial services storytelling — actively adapting best practices for application within Citi Wealth's global content program.
Contribute to strategic planning processes — bringing strong analytic acumen and a results-driven orientation to how priorities are set, resources are allocated, and performance is evaluated.

Capabilities Messaging & Investment Value Proposition

Drive the development of clear, compelling capabilities messaging that articulates Citi Wealth's investment offerings and overall investment management value proposition — with the precision and authority that sophisticated clients and their advisors demand.
Ensure that investment messaging is consistently differentiated, intellectually rigorous, and aligned with the firm's broader brand and communications standards — across all formats and all markets.
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Citi Wealth's investment strategies across asset classes — equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternatives — and translate that understanding into content that is accurate, engaging, and compliant across written, visual, audio, and experiential formats.

Multi-Format Content Production

Lead the development of client-facing and educational content across the full format spectrum — written collateral including whitepapers, brochures, capability overviews, fact sheets, and sales decks; video content including investment outlooks, expert interviews, explainer series, and social edits; audio content including podcasts and recorded commentaries; and event and experiential content including panel programmes, conference presentations, and client experience activations.
Work closely with Citi Wealth's investment teams, product, legal, compliance, and the broader content and production team — including editors, cinematographers, and designers — to ensure all output is technically accurate, appropriately approved, and produced to the highest standard across every format.
Bring the same editorial rigor and audience intelligence to a two-page At a Glance as to a flagship long-form video series or a keynote conference program — understanding that quality and clarity are non-negotiable at every scale.
Understand the specific demands of each format — what a podcast requires that a whitepaper does not; what a live event demands that a social edit cannot deliver — and bring genuine content intelligence to how Citi Wealth's investment stories are matched to the right medium.

Product Launch & Program Support

Manage global compliance coordination as it relates to Citi Wealth investment product launches — including training materials, after-sales support content, and ongoing digital channel maintenance.
Ensure that all product launch content activity is planned, coordinated, and executed with the diligence that a regulated, global financial services environment demands — on time, fully approved, and audit-ready.
Maintain comprehensive legal and compliance approval records for all content materials — upholding the highest standards of process integrity and regulatory accountability.

Reporting & Ongoing Program Management

Manage the standard reporting process across Citi Wealth's investment strategies — including Portfolio Manager commentaries, monthly and quarterly fact sheets, sales deck updates, and investment review publications.
Ensure that all recurring program deliverables — written, video, audio, and event — are produced to schedule, to standard, and through a well-managed, clearly documented production process, with appropriate review and sign-off at every stage.
Identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and modernize the reporting and program management process — recommending and implementing changes that increase efficiency without compromising quality or compliance.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Treat the measurement of content impact as a discipline, not an afterthought. Remaining conscious of clear metrics for Citi Wealth's investment content program across all formats and tracking performance against them with rigor and consistency.
Evaluate the effectiveness of content in supporting business development and client engagement — tracking impact from content engagement and event attendance through to contribution to the business pipeline, and feeding those learnings back into how content is developed, prioritized, and evolved.
Stay current with available measurement tools and analytics platforms across written, video, audio, and event formats — adopting new approaches as they emerge and continuously improving the accuracy and relevance of the team's performance intelligence.
Present performance insights to senior stakeholders in business-relevant terms — connecting content activity across all formats to commercial outcomes and investment pipeline contribution.

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Operate with confidence and credibility at senior levels of the organization — navigating a large, complex, matrixed global structure with the diplomatic skill and strategic intelligence that it demands.
Serve as the primary investment content liaison between Citi Wealth's investment teams and key partner functions — including marketing, ICG, Consumer, Internal Communications, and PR — ensuring alignment, consistency, and mutual support across the firm's investment communications ecosystem.
Guide, influence, and convince senior colleagues and occasional external partners through well-reasoned, clearly communicated recommendations — building trust through expertise, reliability, and sound judgment.
Appropriately assess risk in all content decisions — demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and the safeguarding of Citigroup, its clients, and its assets. Adhere to policy, apply sound ethical judgment, and escalate and report control issues with full transparency.

Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in the financial services industry — with a specific focus on wealth management or asset management content strategy, collateral development, and program execution across multiple formats.
Deep, practical knowledge of investment content development within a wealth management or asset management structure — including the regulatory, compliance, and operational frameworks that govern it.
Solid working knowledge of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset class financial products across Citi Wealth's investment product portfolio — with the ability to engage credibly with investment professionals and translate complex strategies into clear, compelling content. Alternatives experience a significant plus.
Proven experience developing and producing investment content across multiple formats — written collateral, video, audio, and live events — with a genuine understanding of what each medium demands and how investment ideas travel differently across them.
Proven ability to develop and execute integrated content strategies across a global, matrixed organization — managing multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex approval processes simultaneously.
Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills — with a demonstrated ability to communicate and influence at multiple seniority levels, including senior investment professionals, business heads, and external clients.
Strong analytic acumen and a results-driven orientation — with experience setting measurable content objectives, tracking performance across formats, and using data to inform decisions and improve the accuracy of future measurement.
Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage a high-volume, deadline-driven program of work across multiple content formats — reprioritizing with agility as business needs evolve.
A proactive approach to process improvement — identifying inefficiencies, recommending solutions, and implementing changes that make the team smarter and faster without compromising standards.

Education:

Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with alternatives content — hedge funds, private equity, private credit, or real assets — within a wealth management or private bank context.
Hands-on experience producing or closely overseeing video, podcast, or live event content within a financial services environment — including an understanding of production workflows, vendor management, and the specific compliance considerations that apply to each format.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content production, marketing automation, and digital analytics platforms — with a proactive approach to adopting new tools as they become available and folding their capabilities into the team's workflow.
International content experience — developing and adapting materials across multiple markets, regulatory jurisdictions, and cultural contexts.

Description

The Content Strategist is responsible for developing and executing comprehensive content strategies that guide customers through a cohesive AWS narrative across every touchpoint of their journey. This role will use our standardized messaging hierarchy to ensure strategic alignment between messaging, audience needs, and business objectives while maintaining consistency in brand voice and customer experience. While the Content Strategist does not own creation of the messaging within the content, they do drive the strategic vision that informs content creators on how best to deliver consistent, personalized, content experiences that educate, engage, and empower customers to make informed decisions.

With a focus on audience engagement and driving consistent storytelling and messaging, the Content Strategist's key responsibilities include conducting audience and content audits, creating content strategies and lifecycle calendars, overseeing content creation (though not necessarily producing it), and analyzing content performance metrics to inform continuous improvement. The role involves collaborating with Content Studio, Digital Strategy, Campaign teams, and subject matter experts to deliver compelling, high-quality content across various platforms and formats while ensuring strategic direction and messaging is consistently executed with each content piece—whether blogs, infographics, or videos, etc. —to strengthen brand voice and tell a cohesive narrative to all decision makers and influencers in the buying process. Additionally, the Content Strategist partners with the Channels team, Digital Strategists, and Content Studio to determine optimal content formats that maximize customer engagement based on persona, customer journey stage, and content placement.

Key job responsibilities

Develop and execute overarching content strategies aligned with AWS goals and target audiences
Conduct thorough audience and content audits to inform strategy
Create and manage content calendars and information architecture
Oversee content creation across various formats (blogs, infographics, videos, etc.)
Optimize content for SEO and multi-platform distribution
Analyze performance metrics and recommend improvements
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, peer marketing teams, subject matter experts, etc) to drive alignment across execution touchpoints.
Ensure brand and messaging consistency across all content
Determine optimal content formats based on persona to drive engagement, lead generation, and brand loyalty

Objectives

Elevate AWS's content strategy to strengthen brand voice, and a consistent narrative across the customer journey to improve audience engagement
Ensure seamless execution of strategic direction across all content pieces
Contribute to measurable results in terms of influencing lead generation, solution adoption, and customer loyalty
Establish AWS as a thought leader through compelling, high-quality content

A day in the life

Own the end-to-end content calendar from ideation to publication
Guide content creators and designers in producing various content formats
Identify trends, content gaps, and audience preferences
Collaborate with data and analytics teams to develop and study KPIs
Work with peer teams to ensure SEO optimization and user-friendly formats
Stay updated on industry trends and algorithm changes affecting content marketing
Manage relationships with internal and external subject matter experts and influencers

About The Team

The Content Strategy team is part of the Customer Experience organization within the Integrated Demand Center. We partner closely with the Digital Strategy team to design and deliver engaging customer experiences throughout the buyer's journey as customers explore AWS solutions to address their business challenges—from AI and data analytics to migration and beyond.

Our team embeds Content Strategists across all Integrated Demand Programs (IDPs) and event workstreams to ensure the right content reaches the right audience at the optimal stage of their journey, creating meaningful touchpoints that guide customers toward solutions that meet their needs.

Basic Qualifications

6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners

Preferred Qualifications

Experience communicating results to stakeholders
Experience guiding creative input, development and execution from concept to completion

Bring a journalist's instincts and a strategist's discipline to everything you write and produce

new_jobs.title: Senior Investments Content Strategist
new_jobs.description:
Citi Wealth is seeking an exceptional Senior Investments Content Strategist to join the Content & Client Engagement team — a senior, strategic role at the intersection of investment expertise, multi-format content production, and client communication.

This is not a support role. You are a recognised authority in investments content strategy — someone who brings deep knowledge of the wealth management investment landscape, a sophisticated understanding of how complex financial strategies are positioned and communicated across formats, and the credibility to operate at the most senior levels of a large, global organisation. You follow the latest developments in your field closely and adapt them with speed and intelligence to the demands of the business.

Your remit spans the full breadth of Citi Wealth's investment product portfolio — from equities and fixed income to multi-asset strategies and alternative investments. You are not a specialist in one asset class or one content format. You are the person who understands how a sophisticated investment idea needs to be expressed differently depending on whether it is a whitepaper for an institutional advisor, a short-form video for a digital channel, a panel discussion at a marquee client conference, or a monthly fact sheet for a relationship manager's client meeting. You move between those formats with fluency and with consistently high standards.

You will partner with senior members of Citi Wealth's global and regional marketing and investment leadership to develop integrated content strategies that bring the firm's investment capabilities to life — across written, video, audio, event, and digital formats. You will be the connective tissue between investment teams, product, legal, compliance, and the broader content function — ensuring that Citi Wealth's investment value proposition is communicated with clarity, precision, and genuine differentiation.

You operate with the same dual metabolism that defines the best investment content professionals: responsive and fast when markets move and opportunities arise; meticulous and considered when developing the flagship collateral, capability narratives, and quarterly programs that form the backbone of Citi Wealth's client communications calendar. You understand that in a regulated financial environment, every word — and every frame — carries weight.

Responsibilities:

Content Strategy & Integrated Campaign Development

Partner with senior members of Citi Wealth's global marketing and regional marketing leads to seek out and develop integrated content strategies and campaigns in alignment with agreed business and marketing plans — across the full spectrum of Citi Wealth's investment product portfolio.
Bring a strategic, audience-first perspective to every brief — ensuring that investment content is grounded in a clear understanding of client needs, competitive positioning, and the prevailing investment landscape.
Stay closely attuned to the latest trends in investment content strategy, wealth management communication, and financial services storytelling — actively adapting best practices for application within Citi Wealth's global content program.
Contribute to strategic planning processes — bringing strong analytic acumen and a results-driven orientation to how priorities are set, resources are allocated, and performance is evaluated.

Capabilities Messaging & Investment Value Proposition

Drive the development of clear, compelling capabilities messaging that articulates Citi Wealth's investment offerings and overall investment management value proposition — with the precision and authority that sophisticated clients and their advisors demand.
Ensure that investment messaging is consistently differentiated, intellectually rigorous, and aligned with the firm's broader brand and communications standards — across all formats and all markets.
Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Citi Wealth's investment strategies across asset classes — equities, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternatives — and translate that understanding into content that is accurate, engaging, and compliant across written, visual, audio, and experiential formats.

Multi-Format Content Production

Lead the development of client-facing and educational content across the full format spectrum — written collateral including whitepapers, brochures, capability overviews, fact sheets, and sales decks; video content including investment outlooks, expert interviews, explainer series, and social edits; audio content including podcasts and recorded commentaries; and event and experiential content including panel programmes, conference presentations, and client experience activations.
Work closely with Citi Wealth's investment teams, product, legal, compliance, and the broader content and production team — including editors, cinematographers, and designers — to ensure all output is technically accurate, appropriately approved, and produced to the highest standard across every format.
Bring the same editorial rigor and audience intelligence to a two-page At a Glance as to a flagship long-form video series or a keynote conference program — understanding that quality and clarity are non-negotiable at every scale.
Understand the specific demands of each format — what a podcast requires that a whitepaper does not; what a live event demands that a social edit cannot deliver — and bring genuine content intelligence to how Citi Wealth's investment stories are matched to the right medium.

Product Launch & Program Support

Manage global compliance coordination as it relates to Citi Wealth investment product launches — including training materials, after-sales support content, and ongoing digital channel maintenance.
Ensure that all product launch content activity is planned, coordinated, and executed with the diligence that a regulated, global financial services environment demands — on time, fully approved, and audit-ready.
Maintain comprehensive legal and compliance approval records for all content materials — upholding the highest standards of process integrity and regulatory accountability.

Reporting & Ongoing Program Management

Manage the standard reporting process across Citi Wealth's investment strategies — including Portfolio Manager commentaries, monthly and quarterly fact sheets, sales deck updates, and investment review publications.
Ensure that all recurring program deliverables — written, video, audio, and event — are produced to schedule, to standard, and through a well-managed, clearly documented production process, with appropriate review and sign-off at every stage.
Identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and modernize the reporting and program management process — recommending and implementing changes that increase efficiency without compromising quality or compliance.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

Treat the measurement of content impact as a discipline, not an afterthought. Remaining conscious of clear metrics for Citi Wealth's investment content program across all formats and tracking performance against them with rigor and consistency.
Evaluate the effectiveness of content in supporting business development and client engagement — tracking impact from content engagement and event attendance through to contribution to the business pipeline, and feeding those learnings back into how content is developed, prioritized, and evolved.
Stay current with available measurement tools and analytics platforms across written, video, audio, and event formats — adopting new approaches as they emerge and continuously improving the accuracy and relevance of the team's performance intelligence.
Present performance insights to senior stakeholders in business-relevant terms — connecting content activity across all formats to commercial outcomes and investment pipeline contribution.

Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Operate with confidence and credibility at senior levels of the organization — navigating a large, complex, matrixed global structure with the diplomatic skill and strategic intelligence that it demands.
Serve as the primary investment content liaison between Citi Wealth's investment teams and key partner functions — including marketing, ICG, Consumer, Internal Communications, and PR — ensuring alignment, consistency, and mutual support across the firm's investment communications ecosystem.
Guide, influence, and convince senior colleagues and occasional external partners through well-reasoned, clearly communicated recommendations — building trust through expertise, reliability, and sound judgment.
Appropriately assess risk in all content decisions — demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and the safeguarding of Citigroup, its clients, and its assets. Adhere to policy, apply sound ethical judgment, and escalate and report control issues with full transparency.

Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in the financial services industry — with a specific focus on wealth management or asset management content strategy, collateral development, and program execution across multiple formats.
Deep, practical knowledge of investment content development within a wealth management or asset management structure — including the regulatory, compliance, and operational frameworks that govern it.
Solid working knowledge of equity, fixed income, and multi-asset class financial products across Citi Wealth's investment product portfolio — with the ability to engage credibly with investment professionals and translate complex strategies into clear, compelling content. Alternatives experience a significant plus.
Proven experience developing and producing investment content across multiple formats — written collateral, video, audio, and live events — with a genuine understanding of what each medium demands and how investment ideas travel differently across them.
Proven ability to develop and execute integrated content strategies across a global, matrixed organization — managing multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and complex approval processes simultaneously.
Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills — with a demonstrated ability to communicate and influence at multiple seniority levels, including senior investment professionals, business heads, and external clients.
Strong analytic acumen and a results-driven orientation — with experience setting measurable content objectives, tracking performance across formats, and using data to inform decisions and improve the accuracy of future measurement.
Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage a high-volume, deadline-driven program of work across multiple content formats — reprioritizing with agility as business needs evolve.
A proactive approach to process improvement — identifying inefficiencies, recommending solutions, and implementing changes that make the team smarter and faster without compromising standards.

Education:

Bachelor's/University degree, Master's degree preferred

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with alternatives content — hedge funds, private equity, private credit, or real assets — within a wealth management or private bank context.
Hands-on experience producing or closely overseeing video, podcast, or live event content within a financial services environment — including an understanding of production workflows, vendor management, and the specific compliance considerations that apply to each format.
Familiarity with AI-assisted content production, marketing automation, and digital analytics platforms — with a proactive approach to adopting new tools as they become available and folding their capabilities into the team's workflow.
International content experience — developing and adapting materials across multiple markets, regulatory jurisdictions, and cultural contexts.
MBA or relevant graduate degree preferred.

Familiarity with conducting market, audience, or competitive research and translating findings into actionable marketing recommendations.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and modern marketing productivity tools.

What Will Make You Stand Out

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret marketing data and performance metrics to guide decisions and improvements.
Strong collaboration, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with peers, leadership, customers, partners, and vendors.
Strong project-management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to independently execute work within established strategic direction.
Adaptability, curiosity, and willingness to develop new capabilities as marketing practices and technology evolve.

Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, FSA benefits

Optimize content for SEO and multi-platform distribution

Own the end-to-end content calendar from ideation to publication

Manage relationships with internal and external subject matter experts and influencers

Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners

About Us

MEDHOST, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee, is a leading provider of healthcare information technology solutions. Serving healthcare facilities nationwide, MEDHOST offers a comprehensive suite of products, including electronic health records (EHR), financial management systems, and patient engagement platforms. Their mission is to empower healthcare organizations to enhance patient care and improve business operations through innovative, user-friendly solutions. In January 2024, MEDHOST was acquired by N. Harris Computer Corporation, further strengthening its position in the healthcare IT industry.
